name: Karriem Riggins
notes: Detroit's jazz-drummer-who-programs, and the entry names the signature precisely: "**the dual capability is the parameter.** As a producer he programs an MPC with heavy, deliberately-unquantised swing — snare early or late of 2&4, kick doubled on a 16th, hats crushed. He frequently plays live drums *over* his own programmed pattern, giving two slightly-misaligned kits at once. **That doubling is the signature.**" So the snare is `layered` with an 8–20 ms window — two kits, one late — the kick density runs 4–6 a bar for the doubling, the hat velocities are crushed to a 0.22–0.46 main range, and `swing.amount` is pushed to 0.7, the widest in this section, for the "heavy swing" the entry names. `quantizeStrength` 0.36 is "deliberately unquantised". Harmony is sample-inherited: "his loops come from jazz and soul records, so the harmony is m9/maj7 fragments that do not resolve; loops are short (1–2 bars) and often harmonically incomplete" — `maxChords` 2, a triad weight of 0.04 and a vamp harmonic rhythm. The melody is the beat-tape form: "chopped horn/keys/vocal fragments, vibraphone and Rhodes; instrumental beat-tape forms with very short tracks", which is the riff loop at density 2–6 with a raised `emptyBarBias`, and the arrangement is "sketch-form (60–120 second tracks, abrupt cuts, no hooks)". Bass is "sampled bass filtered and sub-reinforced; upright bass overdubs on the jazz-facing material. No 808 slides" — no `bass808` block, because the sub reinforces a sampled part rather than replacing it. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are every drum probability and velocity and all melody numbers, and `swing.amount` 0.7 — "heavy swing" is a direction, not a ratio. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` re-weighted (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry's harmony line is "sample-inherited ... loops are short (1-2 bars) and often harmonically incomplete", and the engine's `vamp` value is *one* chord held for the whole clip (`generators::chords`: "One chord for the whole pattern") — so weighting `vamp` at the top rendered a **one**-chord bed the research nowhere describes. The chord motion the entry states is now carried by `1_per_bar` (the pair over a 2-bar cell) and `2_bars_per_chord` (the pair over a 4-bar cell), with `vamp` kept as the minority for the held reading. A 1-2 bar loop is one chord a bar or two, not a single 4-bar hold. ⚠ The split between those two rates is **INFERRED** — the entry names the device, not its rate. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 974/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.22 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "chopped horn/keys/vocal fragments, vibraphone and Rhodes; instrumental beat-tape forms with very short tracks. On vocal records (Erykah Badu, Common, Kanye West placements) he supplies the loop and a live drum overdub.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
